verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a first-party Unity Editor with an inspector that can be extended through custom inspectors, Editor Windows and Property Drawers, and it refers to working with scenes. It does not document a scene viewport, prefabs or scene composition as the primary level-building workflow. Missing for 10: documentation of the scene view/viewport, prefab and scene-composition workflow, evidence that the editor is the primary level-building tool, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a technical artist, a full visual editor — viewport, inspector, prefabs/scene composition — is the primary way to build levels

citations.quote: Unity lets you extend the editor with your own custom inspectors and Editor Windows and you can define how properties are displayed in the inspector with custom Property Drawers
Elevate your scenes with scalable, captivating visuals using the latest advances in rendering, lighting, and visual effects.
